clue.text: One can have variable water temp and variable air temp around ten

definitions.text: One can have variable water temp

indicators.note: around means the scrambled letters surround the piece for ten
variable letters can change, so the words air temp are rearranged

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A thermostat that wobbles both the water and the air temperature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variable' (the second one) rearranges AIR TEMP into MIERTAP, and 'around' puts X inside it after the I.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen or bathroom fitting blending hot and cold supplies lets the user vary how warm the flow is.

clue.text: Speech problem in school is problematical

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the run of words school is problematical

explanation.surface: A lisp is treated as a troublesome issue at school.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across schooL IS Problematical.
explanation.definitionFit: A lisp is a speech impediment in which s sounds come out as th.

clue.text: Undercooked sole to be cooked again?

parts.note: undercooked meat is red, rare in the middle
sole means only, single: one

explanation.surface: A rare piece of fish sent back to the kitchen to be cooked again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sole' looks like the fish but means single, ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done again a second time has been redone, which here is cooking repeated.

clue.text: Train fellow to become a driver

parts.note: to train someone is to coach them
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: Someone is trained up to become a chauffeur.
explanation.definitionFit: A coachman drives a horse-drawn coach, so he is a driver.

clue.text: Give purchase requirements to shop to get sorted out

definitions.meaning: to place an order with a shop for goods wanted
to arrange things tidily, in sequence

explanation.surface: Ordering from the shop so as to get everything sorted.
explanation.definitionFit: Placing an order means asking a shop for goods, and the same phrase means arranging things tidily in sequence.

clue.text: About to go to performance — ticket required

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a turn is a performance, an act on stage

explanation.surface: Someone heading to a show needs a ticket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go to' and 'required' are link words joining the pieces and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A return is a ticket covering both the outward and the homeward journey.

clue.text: Prejudice about French author's grand schemes

indicators.note: about means the prejudice word goes round the author

parts.note: prejudice means bias
Andre Gide was a French novelist

explanation.surface: Bias surrounding a French writer's ambitious plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambitious plans or grandiose concepts are what people call big ideas.

clue.text: The female one associates with loud-mouthed Australians primarily?

definitions.text: The female one associates with loud-mouthed Australians primarily?

parts.note: the female is she
one is I as a Roman numeral

indicators.note: primarily picks the opening letters of loud-mouthed and Australians

explanation.surface: A woman who hangs around with brash Aussie men.
explanation.walkthrough: As a whole the clue describes an Australian woman, which is what the word means in Australian slang.
explanation.definitionFit: In Australian slang a sheila is a woman, the female an Aussie man keeps company with.

clue.text: Employs old piano at first for compositions

indicators.note: at first puts old piano in front of the word for employs

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
employs means uses

explanation.surface: Someone uses an old piano to begin composing.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical works are numbered as opus, plural opuses or opera, meaning compositions.

clue.text: Stay cheerful, displaying a certain amount of neck?

definitions.meaning: to remain brave and optimistic in difficulty

definitions.text: displaying a certain amount of neck?
definitions.meaning: literally lifting the jaw shows some of the throat

explanation.surface: Smile through it, even if it means showing off your neck.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means stay brave and optimistic; taken literally, lifting the jaw exposes some throat.

clue.text: See 10
Basic food no longer fit for consumption round back of shop

indicators.note: round means the word for off goes around the letter

parts.note: food past its best is stale

indicators.note: back of takes the final letter of shop

explanation.surface: Bread gone off at the back of the shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A staple is a basic food eaten routinely, such as bread or rice.

clue.text: Note is a tip about what can provide floral decoration

indicators.note: about here means round and about, so the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: A note says there is a handy tip on flower arranging.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christmas plant with red bracts is a common seasonal decoration in homes.

clue.text: Rags soon looking awful when brought to light

parts.note: a lamp is a light

indicators.note: looking awful means the word soon is in a mess, jumbled

explanation.surface: Tatty clothes soon look terrible when seen in daylight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rags' is a verb, mocks; 'looking awful' turns SOON into OONS.
explanation.definitionFit: To rag someone is to tease them, as satirical pieces mock their targets.

clue.text: Reward for capturing knight, very important fellow

indicators.note: capturing means the reward word holds the knight

parts.note: a price can be a reward, as on a head
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A bounty for taking a knight prisoner, offered to a VIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A prince is a royal son, a man of very high rank.

clue.text: Vehicle with silver in the old city

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: in means silver goes inside the word the

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A car carrying silver into the old part of town.
explanation.definitionFit: Carthage was the ancient Phoenician city in North Africa destroyed by Rome.

clue.text: A poem's terminal pieces

parts.note: the article a becomes an before a vowel
an ode is a poem, so a poem's is an ode's

explanation.surface: The last lines of a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: Anodes are electrodes, the positive terminals of a battery or cell.

clue.text: Testing support when a politician enters

indicators.note: enters means the a and politician go inside the support

parts.note: a sling supports an injured arm
MP is Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Trials of a support device when an MP walks in.
explanation.definitionFit: Sampling is testing a small portion to judge the whole.

clue.text: Sheep seen in brief time going around Ireland

indicators.note: going around means the time word encloses Ireland

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a brief time
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: A sheep spotted briefly touring Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: The merino is a breed of sheep prized for fine wool.

clue.text: Spare jam

definitions.meaning: to spare is to save or keep safe

explanation.surface: Leftover jam.
explanation.definitionFit: To preserve is to save or keep, a sense of spare, and a preserve is a fruit conserve.

clue.text: Birds finally settling in bits of trees (where they like to be)

indicators.note: settling in means the letter goes inside the tree bits

parts.note: roots are parts of trees

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of Birds

explanation.surface: Birds finally settle in the trees, their favourite spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Perches where birds rest at night are their favourite places to be.

clue.text: Goes away with stuff aboard ship

indicators.note: aboard means the stuff word goes inside the ship

parts.note: SS is steamship
to stuff is to cram

explanation.surface: Someone leaves carrying goods on board a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrams is slang for leaves in a hurry, clears off.

clue.text: Boy has favourite pinned up — 'crush'

indicators.note: has means the son contains the next piece

parts.note: a boy is a son

indicators.note: pinned up in a down clue means the word for favourite is read upwards

parts.note: a pet is a favourite

explanation.surface: A lad has a poster of his heartthrob pinned on the wall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crush' looks like an infatuation but is the verb; 'pinned up' turns PET into TEP.
explanation.definitionFit: To tread on something is to squash it underfoot.

clue.text: Chap's toe is awkwardly placed in coach

indicators.note: awkwardly placed means the letters are set out in a jumbled order

explanation.surface: A man's toe sticking out uncomfortably in a carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A post-chaise was a horse-drawn travelling carriage hired from stage to stage.

clue.text: Do business, as you might say, in tiny premises?

indicators.note: as you might say means spoken out, a sound-alike

parts.note: to do business is to sell

explanation.surface: Trading in a very small shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A prison or monastery cell is a tiny room, small living quarters.

clue.text: Confusion about energy supplier

parts.note: c is circa, about
oil is a fuel that supplies energy

explanation.surface: Muddle over who provides the power.
explanation.definitionFit: Coil in an old sense means turmoil or fuss, as in this mortal coil.

clue.text: Several things that could make one cry?

definitions.text: Several things that could make one cry?

parts.words: Several things that could make one cry?
parts.note: sounds like a list of sorrows but means a plaited bunch of a tear-inducing vegetable

explanation.surface: A collection of sad things.
explanation.definitionFit: Onions release a vapour that brings tears when chopped, so a plaited bunch of them holds many tear-jerkers.
